headline: What does my energy say about why money won't stay?
note:
FRAME: money — the strictest guard on the funnel. No amount, no date, no source, no financial advice, never blames her, never 'too late', never presumes she is broke.

🔴 Beat 4 says the money has not LANDED or not STAYED — never that she has none.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

FINDING: 'the getting works; the keeping is the question' — beat 3a 'the getting has always worked', beat 5b 'hold of it'.

🔴 The premise is that money COMES AND GOES — so this is the one money lander where beat 4 may say it leaves. It still never says she has none. ⛔ Never 'careless with it' even to deny it: raising the word plants it.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing told them apart, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. Four things on it, and all of them still in place.
You asked what your energy says about money not staying. What catches me is that all four things sit on that table.
Still, it doesn't stay, dear. It comes in and then it's gone again.
Whatever is here holds steady, and nothing about it changes. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and yours was held by one rope.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and the rest hangs free.
You asked what your energy says about money not staying. What holds my eye is the single line of it.
And yet it doesn't stay. And you've put that down to something in you.
Something sits at the point where it would settle. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind it…
c: You turned the Fool. You couldn't see them, and you chose the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. Small, and tied shut.
You asked what your energy says about money not staying. How little is being carried — that's the part I keep looking at.
But it doesn't stay. And you're the one asking why it goes.
Something turns up just as the money would stay. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
